name: The Chief
description: Five three-minute AMRAPs of 3 power cleans, 6 push-ups and 9 air squats, with a minute of rest between them. You record the rounds finished in each.
source_notes: crossfit.com/workout/2008/09/14 (official CrossFit daily workout archive, first posted), retrieved 2026-10-16; five 3-minute AMRAP cycles with 1 minute of rest, post the rounds completed in each; the page lists a single load
